A rectangle has length \(a+2\) and width \(a\). How can its perimeter be expressed as a polynomial?
A square has a side length of \((x+1)\) cm. When \(x=4\), what is its perimeter in cm?
The side lengths of a triangle are \(a\) cm, \((a+2)\) cm, and \((2a-1)\) cm. What is its perimeter in cm?

The first side of a triangle is \((3a+2)\) cm long. The second side is \((a-1)\) cm longer than the first, and the third side is 3 cm shorter than the second. The perimeter simplifies to \(pa+q\), where \(p\) and \(q\) are constants. Find the value of \(p+q\).
Is \(x=2\) a solution of the equation \(3x-1=5\)? (Answer “yes” or “no.”)
acceptedAnswers: It is a solution of the equation

How can \(x=3\) be obtained from \(2x=6\)?

choices.B: Multiply both sides of the equation by 5.
choices.C: Divide both sides of the equation by 5.
choices.D: Subtract 5 from both sides of the equation.

Use the properties of equality to solve \(\frac{2}{3}x-1=7\) for \(x\).

Solve \(\frac{x}{2}+\frac{x}{3}=5\). (Enter only the value of \(x\).)
Solve \(\frac{2x-1}{3}=\frac{x+2}{2}\). (Enter only the value of \(x\).)
Solve \(\frac{x-1}{2}-\frac{2x+1}{3}=1\). (Enter only the value of \(x\).)
3 times a number minus 5 equals 16. Find the number.
2 times a number plus 3 equals 15. Let the number be \(x\). Which equation represents this statement?
A class has 45 students, with 5 more boys than girls. How many girls are there?
The sum of three consecutive even numbers is 78. What is the largest of these even numbers?
A can complete a job alone in 6 days, and B can complete it alone in 12 days. How many days will they need working together? (Unit: days)
A can complete a job alone in 3 days, and B can complete it alone in 6 days. How many days will they need to complete it working together? (Unit: days)

A workshop has 28 workers producing bolts and nuts. Each worker can produce 12 bolts or 18 nuts per day, and 1 bolt requires 2 nuts. How many workers should be assigned to produce bolts so that the bolts and nuts produced each day match exactly in the required ratio?

A and B are 100 km apart and travel toward each other at speeds of 30 and 20 km/h. After how many hours will they meet? (Unit: hours)
A and B start simultaneously from two places 60 km apart and travel toward each other at speeds of 4 km/h and 6 km/h, respectively. After how many hours will they meet? (Unit: hours)
A starts traveling at 4 km/h. After 2 hours, B starts from the same place in the same direction at 6 km/h. How many hours after B starts will B catch up with A? (Unit: hours)
